channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Family mourn ‘Hamas leader’ killed in Israeli attack
item.description: A funeral has been held for Mohammed Odeh, believed to be the leader of Hamas’s military wing.

item.title: Bangladesh seeks IMF aid: How badly has Iran war hit its economy?
item.description: The International Monetary Fund warns that Iran war could trigger a spike in global debt levels.

item.title: US, Iran have launched multiple attacks during ceasefire: A timeline
item.description: Washington carried out new strikes on southern Iran, while Tehran downed a US drone and fired at a fighter jet.

item.title: Israel orders evacuation of Lebanese city as conflict with Hezbollah escalates
item.description: Israel's military tells residents of Tyre it will "act forcefully" against the armed group, after another wave of strikes in south and east Lebanon.

item.title: Israeli strike in Gaza City kills new head of Hamas's military wing
item.description: Hamas says Mohammed Odeh was killed alongside his wife and two children in a strike on a residential building.

item.title: One killed and nine missing after chemical explosion at US paper mill
item.description: Nine others were injured and another nine are missing after a tank ruptured at a paper mill in Longview, Washington.

item.title: Iran condemns US strikes as 'gross violation' of ceasefire
item.description: The attacks took place while Iranian and Qatari negotiators were in Doha for peace talks.

item.title: Almost 500,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, GCHQ says
item.description: GCHQ's director Anne Keast-Butler set out the threats facing the UK in her inaugural public speech.
